change.title: Prevent cross-account adoption of unowned Editor workspace cache
root_cause: When an authenticated user's server workspace was absent, startup copied the browser's unscoped workspace cache into that account's saved preferences.
The Inspector tab was initialized from the same unscoped dock key before identity resolution.
Account-specific workspace updates did not consistently restore appearance and mobile desktop-intent when the owner key changed.
implementation: Namespace appearance and shell/dock preferences under the authenticated user ID, rejecting empty, malformed, non-ASCII, and path-like identifiers.
Do not synchronize an unowned global cache as a new account's initial server workspace; only an existing owner-scoped cache may be adopted.
Resolve Inspector selection from the active account's workspace after owner/server hydration; preserve the anonymous local workspace path.
Preserve legacy appearance recovery and the desktop dock intent while maintaining canvas-first mobile rendering.
Bump app and shell asset query versions for immediate production cache invalidation.
